WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cat_is, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_was = cp.category THEN 0 ELSE n.net_sales END) AS moved_by_restatement,
       MIN(d.calendar_date) AS mind, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS maxd
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
       min(sale_date) AS d0, max(sale_date) AS d1
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-18' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-18' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dispatch_null_or_status', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), min(order_ts_utc)::DATE, max(order_ts_utc)::DATE
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-11-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31'

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) AS c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-18' AND DATE '2025-12-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sale_date, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, d.c
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d ON d.receipt_id = f.receipt_id AND d.line_no = f.line_no
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 30

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-18' AND DATE '2025-12-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, p.category, s.store_id, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups x ON x.receipt_id = f.receipt_id AND x.line_no = f.line_no
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4 LIMIT 60

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.business_date, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY ALL
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.business_date, r.store_id, r.net_sales AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_year) AS fy, count(*) AS cells, sum(COALESCE(m.mine,0)) AS mine, sum(COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) AS ctl,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_cells
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date = m.business_date AND c.store_id = m.store_id AND c.fiscal_year = m.fiscal_year
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_year AS (
    SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       py.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / py.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM by_year ty JOIN by_year py ON py.category = ty.category AND py.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.category
